decisions.physicalWaxFormat: 16 baseball cards plus 1 Magic Motion trivia card; 36 packs per box.
decisions.vcsPackFormat: 17 total slots; guaranteed Magic Motion leaves 16 base cards normally. Young Superstars replaces another base slot on a hit.
decisions.rackExclusiveConversion: One Young Superstars Set 1 per rack containing 48 base cards plus that bonus (49 baseball cards) and 3 trivia cards. 48/16=3 wax-equivalent packs gives 1:3 VCS odds. Deliberate channel approximation, not historical wax odds.
decisions.subsets: 1990 Rookies 580-657, Draft Picks 661-682, Dream Team 683-695, selected highlights and World Series cards remain in complete Base.
decisions.boJackson697: Canonical name Bo Jackson; baseball team Kansas City Royals derived from other Bo Jackson cards in this checklist. Normal base availability, not short printed.
decisions.variations: 18 additional source error/variation rows collapse into corrected/later b states.
decisions.exclusions: Ten Rookie Dream Team cards are Hobby factory-set exclusives. Young Superstars Set 2 is a separate mail-in/boxed set. Promos, Rookie/Traded, McDonalds and other boxed products excluded.
decisions.magicMotion: All 56 MVP trivia subjects retain historical team and award league/year metadata; no inferred RC labels.
